input.quote: 11.1 For Convenience. Customer may terminate this Agreement during the Term upon at least one (1) years' written notice to M&I, provided that Customer pays M&I an early termination fee ("Termination for Convenience Fee") in an amount equal to REDACTED of the Estimated Remaining Value.
input.rationale: The Term runs eight years (p0049) and the only Customer convenience exit (11.1) requires a full year's written notice plus an early-termination fee measured as a percentage of the Estimated Remaining Value (p0039), i.e. the Monthly Base Fee multiplied by every month left in an up-to-eight-year term, expressly carved out of the Section 13.4 liability limitation. Both material terms (notice and fee) fail the fallback, so this is a deviation. Because the deterministic fallback checks for a Vendor end-of-term convenience right cannot pass (the Agreement contains no M&I convenience-termination provision to restrict), we have taken the whole proposal to the preferred level: 30 days' notice, no early-termination fee, a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and removal of M&I's right under Section 10.2 (p0180) to withdraw Services for convenience during the committed Term.

ops.oldText: Customer may terminate this Agreement during the Term upon at least one (1) years' written notice to M&I, provided that Customer pays M&I an early termination fee ("Termination for Convenience Fee") in an amount equal to REDACTED of the Estimated Remaining Value.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement during the Term upon at least 30 days' written notice to M&I, provided that Customer pays M&I no early termination fee ("Termination for Convenience Fee") and M&I pays Customer a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.

ops.oldText: M&I may, at any time, withdraw any of the Services
ops.newText: M&I may not, during the Term, withdraw any of the Services

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We moved the convenience exit to 30 days' written notice, replaced the percentage-of-Estimated-Remaining-Value fee with no fee plus a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and removed M&I's right to withdraw Services for convenience during the committed Term.
proposal.summary: Cut the Customer convenience notice to 30 days, remove the early-termination fee, add a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and bar M&I from withdrawing Services for convenience during the Term.
